dct_description_sm: Hardware installations used to count pedestrian and cyclist traffic along major active transportation routes. Tablular data generated by this equipment can be joined to these locations by matching the ID and LOC_ID fields. This data is updated on a monthly basis. *Note: Due to LRT construction in many areas throughout the City, pedestrian and cyclist traffic has been diverted around many EcoCounter installations resulting in a perceived drop in traffic.
